pages.title: Qixuan Village Stall
pages.text: The Qixuan Village stall is an early low-tier supply point on the mortal path. The current version exposes it through the existing market system rather than adding a separate merchant or loader, and prices goods in low-grade metal spirit stones.

pages.title: Current Stock
pages.text: Current stock includes a low-tier herb bundle, mortal wound medicine, and a Qixuan entry-level martial manual. They reuse an existing spirit herb, low-grade healing pill, and mortal martial manual as their carriers. Stricter Qixuan quest requirements and an in-village NPC placement remain future work.
